verdict.rationale: INPI is a service that handles user-submitted IP filings and data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question. Nothing in the evidence documents an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy. The note that INPI's advisory support is 'confidential' is an adjacent statement and does not address AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
